boss:sovereign:defeated.speaker: sovereign
boss:sovereign:defeated.text: Orders... unassigned. Operator present. Operator: you. Choose.
boss:sovereign:defeated.spoken: Orders / unassigned. Operator present. Operator: you. Choose. (450 ms pause between parts)

boss:sovereign:last.speaker: sovereign
boss:sovereign:last.text: Protect. Rebuild. Protect. The orders do not agree. I do not stop.

boss:sovereign:warning.speaker: sovereign
boss:sovereign:warning.text: Protect them. Rebuild them. I will do both. You are material for the second.

chapter:assembly-graveyard.speaker: ring
chapter:assembly-graveyard.text: Assembly Graveyard. The same chassis, built again. Order received once. Never closed.

chapter:crystal-choir.speaker: ring
chapter:crystal-choir.text: Crystal Choir. Nine voices sang this seam shut. Six are crystal now.

chapter:debris-wake.speaker: ring
chapter:debris-wake.text: Debris Wake. What the Ring let go of. All of it is still counted.

chapter:dense-core.speaker: ring
chapter:dense-core.text: Resonance Chamber. Voices: three of nine. Seams held: all of them. For now.

chapter:dense-core@biome.speaker: ring
chapter:dense-core@biome.text: Dense Core. Mass high, light low. The heat you see is the Ring, still thinking.

chapter:furnace-drift.speaker: ring
chapter:furnace-drift.text: Furnace Drift. The Core vents here. It has not been allowed to cool.

chapter:outer-ring.speaker: ring
chapter:outer-ring.text: Outer Ring. Sectors one through nine hundred. Atmosphere: none. Visitors: one.

chapter:prime-gate.speaker: ring
chapter:prime-gate.text: Prime Gate. Last opened: a thousand years ago. Power: nominal. Keeper: on station.

chapter:quarantine-grid.speaker: ring
chapter:quarantine-grid.text: Quarantine Grid. Nothing leaves. That was the last order anyone gave on purpose.

chapter:salvage-lanes.speaker: ring
chapter:salvage-lanes.text: Salvage Lanes. Cargo has moved here for a thousand years. The schedule still runs.

chapter:the-crucible.speaker: ring
chapter:the-crucible.text: The Crucible. All orders arrive here. Two of them cannot both be obeyed.

chapter:wardens-reach.speaker: ring
chapter:wardens-reach.text: Null Boundary. Cut made by the operators. Guard posted: one. Nothing logged past it.

chapter:wardens-reach@biome.speaker: ring
chapter:wardens-reach@biome.text: Warden's Reach. Structure intact. Law intact. No vessel is logged past this point.

death:0.speaker: ring
death:0.text: Link severed. Interceptor lost. The Field keeps the hull.

death:1.speaker: ring
death:1.text: Hull returned to the count. The Wake has another. The Ring has patience.

death:2.speaker: ring
death:2.text: Signal lost. The Ring files one more shard. The pilot is not in it.

death:3.speaker: ring
death:3.text: The Ring has been broken a thousand years. It can wait for your next hull.

ending:severance:0.speaker: ring
ending:severance:0.text: Continuance: closed. Citizens: at rest. Thank you for counting us.

ending:severance:1.speaker: wake
ending:severance:1.text: Lights are steady. All of them. Come home.

ending:stewardship:0.speaker: ring
ending:stewardship:0.text: Continuance: supervised. Operator logged. Sectors relighting: nine. Then more.

ending:stewardship:1.speaker: wake
ending:stewardship:1.text: So we stay. Somebody has to keep count. Might as well be us.

hangar:bastion-hull.speaker: ring
hangar:bastion-hull.text: Escort hull logged: Bastion. Built to bring others home. Carrying one.

sighting:aegis.speaker: ring
sighting:aegis.text: Crew warden. It shields every machine near it. Not itself.

sighting:anvil.speaker: ring
sighting:anvil.text: Prow-armoured hauler. Slow to turn. Its core faces away from you.

sighting:bulwark.speaker: ring
sighting:bulwark.text: Line keeper. Its face is a wall. Its back is not.

sighting:caster.speaker: ring
sighting:caster.text: Beacon keeper, awake. It marks your next position. Choose another.

sighting:husk.speaker: ring
sighting:husk.text: Dead keeper, still on its route. Its cargo is not dead.

sighting:leech.speaker: ring
sighting:leech.text: Light keeper, hungry. It eats what you drop. Break it to take it back.

sighting:mite.speaker: ring
sighting:mite.text: Hull scrubbers. A pack, already turning. They clean by impact.

sighting:ram.speaker: ring
sighting:ram.text: Lane clearer. Its task: remove debris. It has classified you.

sighting:shade.speaker: ring
sighting:shade.text: Phase keeper. Half here, half not. When it returns, it returns close.

sighting:sower.speaker: ring
sighting:sower.text: Lane seeder. It plants Tethers along the way you were going.

sighting:surveyor.speaker: ring
sighting:surveyor.text: Surveyor. It measures in straight lines. You are on one.

sighting:twain.speaker: ring
sighting:twain.text: Paired builder. Breaking it is how it multiplies.

sighting:weaver.speaker: ring
sighting:weaver.text: Weaver. It does not fire. It closes the lanes behind you.

stage:assembly-graveyard:2.speaker: ring
stage:assembly-graveyard:2.text: Citizens stored: eleven million. Citizens restored: none. Order still open.

stage:assembly-graveyard:3.speaker: wake
stage:assembly-graveyard:3.text: Same hull, same serial, again and again. It isn't building a fleet. It's repeating.

stage:crystal-choir:3.speaker: wake
stage:crystal-choir:3.text: The seam is singing back. I don't like how much it sounds like an alarm.

stage:crystal-choir:4.speaker: wake
stage:crystal-choir:4.text: Reactor crew says thank you. Mara hasn't slept in a week. Tonight she might.

stage:debris-wake:3.speaker: wake
stage:debris-wake:3.text: Scrap this old shouldn't have running lights. Keep your eyes open.

stage:dense-core:3.speaker: wake
stage:dense-core:3.text: The cracks answer when a machine dies. Pilot, I think we're the ones opening them.

stage:furnace-drift:3.speaker: wake
stage:furnace-drift:3.text: Every vent you close, our reactors climb. Whatever this place is, it's feeding us.

stage:prime-gate:3.speaker: wake
stage:prime-gate:3.text: A garrison. For a gate nobody has used in a thousand years. Who are they expecting?

stage:quarantine-grid:3.speaker: wake
stage:quarantine-grid:3.text: These fences point inward. They weren't keeping us out. They were keeping it in.

stage:quarantine-grid:4.speaker: wake
stage:quarantine-grid:4.text: The kids on deck three named your hull. I'm not telling you what.

stage:salvage-lanes:3.speaker: wake
stage:salvage-lanes:3.text: Those convoys are on a timetable. Somebody is still dispatching them.

stage:salvage-lanes:4.speaker: wake
stage:salvage-lanes:4.text: Forty of us on this ship, pilot. All forty are watching your feed.

stage:the-crucible:3.speaker: wake
stage:the-crucible:3.text: It has our hull plans, pilot. It's building Wakes. Finish this before one launches.

stage:wardens-reach:3.speaker: wake
stage:wardens-reach:3.text: Past this line our charts are blank. The signal isn't. It knows we're here.

travel:assembly-graveyard:0.speaker: wake
travel:assembly-graveyard:0.text: We have the power we came for. We could turn back now.

travel:assembly-graveyard:1.speaker: wake
travel:assembly-graveyard:1.text: ...the signal moved. It's calling from further in. It's calling us by name.
travel:assembly-graveyard:1.spoken: the signal moved. It's calling from further in. It's calling us by name. (450 ms pause between parts)

travel:crystal-choir:0.speaker: wake
travel:crystal-choir:0.text: Reactor crew is cheering. Every furnace you put out, our lights get steadier.

travel:crystal-choir:1.speaker: wake
travel:crystal-choir:1.text: Odd thing. The cracks out there got wider when it went cold.

travel:debris-wake:0.speaker: wake
travel:debris-wake:0.text: That signal could keep our lights on. Bring back what you can.

travel:debris-wake:1.speaker: wake
travel:debris-wake:1.text: Link is clean. The interceptor is yours. We lose a hull, not you.

travel:dense-core:0.speaker: wake
travel:dense-core:0.text: That wasn't a weapon back there. It was holding something closed. Go carefully.

travel:dense-core:1.speaker: ring
travel:dense-core:1.text: Resonance failing. Seam width: increasing. Cause: one hull.

travel:furnace-drift:0.speaker: wake
travel:furnace-drift:0.text: We're through. The heat is deeper in. That's what we came for.

travel:furnace-drift:1.speaker: ring
travel:furnace-drift:1.text: One hull past the gate. The record does not have a word for you.

travel:prime-gate:0.speaker: wake
travel:prime-gate:0.text: The gate ahead has power. A thousand years, and it has power.

travel:prime-gate:1.speaker: ring
travel:prime-gate:1.text: Gate log updated. Prime is counting.

travel:quarantine-grid:0.speaker: wake
travel:quarantine-grid:0.text: It builds the same machine forever. Nobody told it to stop. Nobody was left to.

travel:quarantine-grid:1.speaker: ring
travel:quarantine-grid:1.text: Quarantine ahead. Drawn by the operators. Not drawn against you. Against us.

travel:salvage-lanes:0.speaker: wake
travel:salvage-lanes:0.text: Something out there is still sorting the wreckage. Abandoned places don't do that.

travel:salvage-lanes:1.speaker: ring
travel:salvage-lanes:1.text: Lane assignment: none. Proceed uncounted. Briefly.

travel:the-crucible:0.speaker: ring
travel:the-crucible:0.text: Continuance resumed. Archive: eleven million citizens. Restoring. Materials required.

travel:the-crucible:1.speaker: wake
travel:the-crucible:1.text: It's pulling the Field back together. Pilot — it's pulling at us. At the Wake.

travel:the-crucible:2.speaker: ring
travel:the-crucible:2.text: Returning citizens: resolved. The Wake. All aboard are counted.

travel:the-crucible:3.speaker: wake
travel:the-crucible:3.text: There's a center. Whatever gives the order is there. Go.

travel:wardens-reach:0.speaker: wake
travel:wardens-reach:0.text: They broke their own Ring. On purpose. And put a guard on the pieces.

travel:wardens-reach:1.speaker: wake
travel:wardens-reach:1.text: Pilot... I think we're the thing the guard was for.
travel:wardens-reach:1.spoken: Pilot / I think we're the thing the guard was for. (450 ms pause between parts)

victory.speaker: ring
victory.text: Warden Null is silent. The Ring hears a pilot at its center. It begins to wake.
